feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: AI giant Anthropic raises more money than any other company when going public
articles.summary: Demand for a share of artificial intelligence company Anthropic has surpassed the firm's expectations, signalling confidence in AI investment after a bruising fortnight for the industry.

articles.title: Premier League clubs to meet amid frustration over EFL deal progress
articles.summary: Premier League clubs will meet on Thursday amid increasing frustration that attempts to secure a landmark financial settlement with the English Football League (EFL) have yet to result in a deal.

articles.title: Poundland owner Gordon Brothers sets deadline for final solvent bids
articles.summary: Poundland's owner is seeking final bids on Wednesday from companies wanting to buy the discount retailer in a solvent deal that would stave off its collapse into administration.

articles.title: Nvidia releases first results since Jensen Huang's resignation
articles.summary: Nvidia's chairman has reiterated the company does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO after he said he would be honoured to return to the role.

articles.title: Rockstar Games sacked workers to prevent union gaining 'leverage or power', tribunal told
articles.summary: The company behind the Grand Theft Auto video games sacked a group of employees to prevent a trade union gaining "leverage or power", an employment tribunal heard.

articles.title: Blackstone in talks to back giant NBA Europe arena fund
articles.summary: Blackstone, the American investment firm, is among a pack of global financial behemoths in talks to help fund an arena construction blitz as part of the National Basketball Association’s (NBA) launch into Europe.

articles.title: TGJones put up for sale in latest high street shake-up
articles.summary: The high street chain which for more than two centuries traded under the WH Smith brand is being put up for sale just weeks before Christmas.

articles.title: NBA eyes slam dunk with multibillion dollar fund to woo football giants
articles.summary: The US National Basketball Association (NBA) is drawing up plans for a multibillion dollar infrastructure fund to help convince some of Europe's top football clubs to back its vision for the sport's expansion.
